{{Quote|We have a crisis. One of the conference participants brought a servant, a man named Melloc Fitzal. It turns out Fitzal was a covert agent for Imperial Security.|[[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]], to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:SPN" />}}
'''Melloc Fitzal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] servant who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We screened all transmission devices before the conference, but Fitzal got out undetected and has met an escort of storm commandos in the wilderness. If he gets back to the city alive, the entire Resistance on Naboo will be finished. Assemble a strike team and stop him!|Pooja Naberrie, to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:SPN" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Melloc Fitzal worked as a servant for a [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]]. At some point, Fitzal was approached by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] who convinced him to spy his master who was presumed to be a sympathizer of the anti-Imperial [[Naboo Resistance (Galactic Civil War)|Naboo Resistance]].<ref name="SWG:SPN" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> ex-[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]], the leader of the Naboo Resistance, organized a conclave of Naboo aristocrats sympathetic to the rebellion. Melloc Fitzal's master was invited to the conference that took place near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]], and Fitzal accompanied him. Although the spy was quickly identified because he was carrying a [[Listening device/Legends|listening device]], Fitzal successfully escaped in the Naboo wilderness with critical information. A group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives was immediately sent after after him by Naberrie but they were too late to prevent him to join a squad of [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commando]] that was deployed in the neighborhood in case the spy needed backup. However, the Rebel strike team was able to eliminate this escort during the ensuring fight. Melloc Fitzal was also killed, before he could transmit any information.<ref name="SWG:SPN" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:HeroskBalfar.jpg|175px|thumb|Melloc Fitzal erroneously spawned as Herosk Bal'far under one of forty-two possible depictions.]]
Melloc Fitzal was intended to be a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SPN" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Players who performed a series of [[W:c:swg:Quest|quests]] for [[W:c:swg:Pooja Naberrie|Pooja Naberriehad]] had to locate Fitzal outside of [[W:c:swg:Dee'ja Peak|Dee'ja Peak]] and kill him. However, due to a bug, many of the NPCs in Naberrie's quests were not properly sequenced. For instance, in the quest to kill Fitzal, players actually encountered an individual known as [[Herosk Bal'far]], who was supposed to appear in a previous quest.<ref name="SWG:SPN" /> According to the game files, killing Fitzal would not result in a mission success, as the character (in this case Herosk Bal'far) was not designated as a "destroy" NPC.<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref> Nevertheless, it was possible for the player to complete the mission by escorting Fitzal back to Naberrie in Dee'ja Peak. This article assumes that the content of Naberrie's quest dialogue is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, and that Fitzal, not Herosk Bal'far, actually appeared during her sixth and final quest.<ref name="SWG:SPN" />

Furthermore, because Melloc Fitzal lacked a proper character model, the canonical [[Species/Legends|species]] could not be definitively determined in the ''Star Wars'' Legends continuity. However, the quest dialogue identified Fitzal as a male.<ref name="SWG:SPN" /> The questline that involved Fitzal was eventually removed from the game when Pooja Naberrie was relocated to [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] as part of the newly introduced [[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]], released as part of [[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15 2005|Publish 25's]] [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="NGE">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
